niche_preference_profile: This user most often prefers interfaces that are visually clean, clearly structured, and easy to scan, with strong hierarchy, concise copy, and explicit action emphasis. They frequently favor light neutral backgrounds with dark text and restrained purple accents, though in some tool-like or premium dark-theme contexts they also respond well to deep navy surfaces over charcoal. They tend to like simpler layouts with fewer competing elements, flatter list or row-based organization instead of many boxed cards, and controls that feel obvious, labeled, and active. They also repeatedly prefer balanced spacing, readable contrast, and content presentations that surface useful information efficiently without decorative clutter.

top_7_criteria.description: Prefers strong sectioning, obvious headings, clear grouping, explicit ordering, and layouts where primary content and actions are easy to identify and scan.
Prefers fewer decorative elements, less busy chrome, fewer competing panels, and cleaner screens that keep attention on the main task or content.
Often prefers light neutral backgrounds, dark readable text, soft gray surfaces, and restrained purple accents over darker or more saturated alternatives.
Prefers calmer vertical rhythm, clearer separation between sections, and enough whitespace to avoid cramped or crowded presentation.
Prefers prominent, active-looking primary buttons, explicit completion controls, labeled actions, and stronger separation between primary and secondary actions.
Prefers concise, scannable content that surfaces useful information efficiently—often favoring compact rows or integrated visible options over hidden, sparse, or overly verbose presentations.
Prefers flatter list rows, grouped containers, subtle borders/dividers, and lighter card treatment instead of many heavy, boxed, glowy, or highly modular cards.
